purpose: Collect source-verifiable positive and negative real-life events for the frozen V5 DEV roster before any astrology feature generation.
core_rules: Research each subject only within preassigned_axis.
Record all eligible major events found during the bounded source sweep, not only pair-friendly events.
Do not inspect astrology, Control scores, chronology balance, pairability, or model outputs during event collection.
Positive and negative events require explicit source-verifiable outcomes.
Do not replace subjects because events are sparse or difficult to find.
Same-year positive and negative collisions are retained for QA but cannot form a final pair.
Routine term completion, retirement, ordinary government turnover, or normal resignation is not automatically a negative STATUS event.
Legal, health, or reputation disruption is not a core STATUS negative unless the source-verifiable mechanism is a direct loss of status/office/authority under the STATUS definition.
Event eligibility must be decided before looking at any astrology feature.
No CONFIRM event research until one candidate architecture is frozen after DEV.

per_subject_sequence: 1. One broad biographical/reference source to build the career timeline.
2. One authoritative or primary source where available for major candidate events.
3. Up to two reputable independent sources for verification/clarification of candidate events.
bounded_source_sweep.stop_rule: Stop after the bounded sweep has covered the major career timeline and no new eligible axis-specific major event appears in the final two consulted sources.

positive_examples: clear ranking breakthrough or record-setting competitive achievement
decisive selection/qualification success when competitively meaningful
negative_examples: loss of title/status through competitive result
clear competitive collapse or failure documented as an outcome
disqualification/competitive sanction when directly part of the competition outcome

positive_examples: major award or critical/commercial breakthrough tied to a specific work
documented comeback project or project milestone
negative_examples: major flop/failure tied to a specific project
major production failure or shelved work
major critically/commercially unsuccessful project when clearly documented

STATUS.unit: formal or clearly observable status/authority outcome
positive_examples: election or appointment to materially higher office
negative_examples: electoral defeat when contesting to retain/gain meaningful office
forced resignation directly tied to loss of authority
major demotion or loss of leadership control
not_automatically_negative: legal/reputation event without direct status loss

event_fields.event_year: integer calendar year of the outcome
event_fields.eligibility_note: why this is an eligible event under the preassigned axis
event_fields.exclude: true only for logged candidate events found during sweep that fail eligibility

collection_batching.assignment: deterministic axis-stratified round-robin after SHA256 ordering
